Package org.drip.sample.reissuance

Optimal Exercise/Bond Re-issuance Calculations
Author:
Lakshmi Krishnamurthy
  • Class Summary
    Class Description
    AROEnsembleCorrelationAnalysis
    AROEnsembleCorrelationAnalysis analyzes the Impact of Yield Curve Weiner Increments the Simulation of an Ensemble of correlated Path of ARO PnL for the specified Bond.
    AROEnsemblePnL
    AROEnsemblePnL illustrates the Simulation of an Ensemble of correlated Path of ARO PnL for the specified Bond.
    AROEnsembleRegimeAnalysis
    AROEnsembleRegimeAnalysis analyzes the Impact of Multi-regime Yield Curve Weiner Dynamics of an Ensemble of correlated Path of ARO PnL for the specified Bond.
    AROEOSEnsemblePnL
    AROEOSEnsemblePnL illustrates the Simulation of an Ensemble of correlated Path of ARO PnL for a Bond with Embedded Option.
    AROPath
    AROPath illustrates the Simulation of a single-correlated Path of ARO PnL for the specified Bond Issue.
    AROPathEOS
    AROPathEOS illustrates the Simulation of a single-correlated Path of ARO PnL for the specified Bond Issue with Embedded Call Option.
    DeGuillaumeRebonatoPogudinDatePath
    DeGuillaumeRebonatoPogudinDatePath illustrates the Simulation of a single Path of Tax-exempt, Taxable, and Escrow Yields.
    ExercisePeriodMarketYieldPath
    ExercisePeriodMarketYieldPath illustrates the Simulation of a single-correlated Path of Tax-exempt, Taxable, and Escrow Yields across the Dates in an Exercise Period.
    IssueBondMarketPnLEnsemble
    IssueBondMarketPnLEnsemble illustrates the Simulation of Correlated Ensemble of Tax-exempt and Taxable PnL across the Dates in an Exercise Period.
    IssueBondMarketPnLPath
    IssueBondMarketPnLPath illustrates the Simulation of a single-correlated Path of Tax-exempt and Taxable PnL across the Dates in an Exercise Period.
    IssueBondNegativeArbitrageEnsemble
    IssueBondNegativeArbitrageEnsemble illustrates the Simulation of Correlated Ensemble of Tax-exempt and Taxable Negative Arbitrage Count across the Dates in an Exercise Period.
